# Civorax Group

> Civorax Group is a Nepali holding company founded in 2019 and headquartered at Itahari-04, Aaitabare, NTC Road, Sunsari, Koshi Province, Nepal. It owns two companies: CivoraX Tech Pvt. Ltd. (civoraxtech.com) and CivoraX Infra Pvt. Ltd. (civoraxinfra.com).

Slogan: "The architecture of tomorrow."
The name CivoraX combines Civ (civilization), Aura (energy and feeling) and X (the future): Civorax Group connects civilization with new energy and carries it into the future — through technology (CivoraX Tech) and infrastructure (CivoraX Infra).

Civorax Group is not affiliated with Civora Nexus or the "CivoraX Internship Programme".

## CivoraX Tech Pvt. Ltd. — "Innovate Smarter. Build Digital. Shape Tomorrow."
